question: Export of goods enhances ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**foreign exchange.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Export of goods **brings** foreign exchange** into the country, which **strengthens the economy.**
 
• Exporting goods increases the demand for **domestically produced goods, **leading to higher production and employment levels.
 
• Exporting goods enhances the **country's reputation** in the global market, which attracts** foreign investment **and promotes **economic growth.**
 
• Exporting goods helps to** diversify the economy, **reducing dependence on a** particular sector or market.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Expenses** may lead to **lower expenses** as production levels increase due to **higher demand.**
 
• **Local debt and nation's loan** are **not **related to exporting goods, but are more dependent on factors like **government policies, fiscal management, and economic conditions.**
